chapter_title: The Ebon Hawk: the ship's own quests
story_position: the ship's own quests between planets; its XP is counted after Korriban, the last of the four free planets in chapter order, by when the droid's four parts (sold or carried on Telos, Nar Shaddaa, Onderon and Dantooine) can all be found, the alignment movie has brought slot 9 on board and the Nar Shaddaa and Korriban visits on the ship are done
about: Story state every completed run of the chapter ends with, for a skip-to-the-end feature. Curated in tools/questdb/chapters.py; values marked certain = false were worked out by reading the scripts or seen in one real save, not proven for every run.

globals.name: 000_Event_Movie
globals.note: k_align_movie (scripts.bif, read from its disassembly), its only writer, sets 1 when it plays the movie that sends slot 9: while it is 0, at an alignment of 75 and above or 25 and below, and in any case once 000_Jedi_Found reaches 3, so every run sees it; at 0 the movie (and the attack) would come again

globals.name: 000_HK_Alive
globals.note: a_createhk47 (drdparts R10); hk47 starts at E384 while it is 1

globals.name: 000_HK_Chassis
globals.note: drdparts E9 (a_hk_chassis) / E10; only 1 is ever written

globals.name: 000_HK_Control_C
globals.note: drdparts E5 / E6; only 1 is ever written

globals.name: 000_HK_Processor
globals.note: drdparts E11 / E12; only 1 is ever written

globals.name: 000_HK_Total_Parts
globals.note: a_global_inc on drdparts R5 to R8, once per part; E13 needs 4

globals.name: 000_HK_Vocab
globals.note: drdparts E7 / E8; only 1 is ever written

globals.name: 003_IN_COMBAT
globals.note: k_003ebo_enter sets 1 for the attack; k_visas_damage sets 0 when slot 9 is beaten; at 1 the exit (tr_leave_ehawk) skips party selection

globals.name: 003EBO_CLEANUP_VISAS
globals.note: the cutscene table sets TRUE when the attack starts (scene VISAS ARRIVES); a_next_scene|1 (003atton R115, the aftermath scene) clears it, and the flag only steers that clean-up, so a finished arrival leaves FALSE

globals.name: 003EBO_VISAS_ARRIVES
globals.note: set TRUE by the alignment movie (k_align_movie, scripts.bif); k_003ebo_enter sets it FALSE when the attack starts

globals.name: GBL_MAIN_SITH_LORD
globals.note: k_align_movie sets 2 with the movie (5 only when GBL_GAME_COMPLETE > 2, which a first run never has). Later writers: dialog atrend3 E0 / E1 (262tel, The Jedi Masters) set 3 or 4, so this side chapter must not be applied to a save past that point

globals.name: VISAS_ARRIVES_CONV
globals.note: set TRUE by a_next_scene's party spawn after the attack and FALSE by visasmarr E171 (a_glob_bool_set 0); whether every run reaches E171 was not worked out
side content or bookkeeping: no end value is set; the editor leaves it unchanged; not in globalcat.2da, so a save does not keep it
